INSERT INTO vm_order_algorithm_config (order_code, industry_code, device_code, algorithm_code, algorithm_type, creator, delete_flag, create_time) VALUES
(#{item.orderCode}, #{item.industryCode}, #{item.deviceCode}, #{item.algorithmCode}, #{item.algorithmType}, #{item.creator}, 0, now())
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_code, industry_code, device_code, algorithm_code, algorithm_type, creator, modifier, delete_flag, create_time, update_time FROM vm_order_algorithm_config WHERE order_code = #{orderCode}

SELECT oral.algorithm_code AS algorithmCode, alg.algorithm_name AS algorithmName FROM vm_order_algorithms oral INNER JOIN vm_algorithm_info_t alg ON alg.algorithm_code = oral.algorithm_code AND alg.delete_flag = '0' AND alg.app_scenarios = #{appScenario} WHERE oral.delete_flag = '0' AND oral.order_code = #{orderCode} GROUP BY oral.algorithm_code
